scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Hey, I know you.
You took this test
before, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
嘿，我認識你。
你以前參加過這個測試，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Ah, you must have been
to Valhalla and been reborn.
Wow, that's so impressive!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
啊，看來你去過瓦爾哈拉並轉生了。
哇，真厲害！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Err...
You'd better learn all the Basic Skills first before you can become an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
那個...
在成為弓箭手之前，你最好先學會所有的基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Alright, see you later.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
好的，回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well then. I don't
need to say anything else.
I know you'll make a great Archer...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
那我就不多說了。
我相信你會成為一名出色的弓箭手...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Although there's no special
reward for you this time, I hope you understand. Take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
不過，這次沒有特別的獎勵，希望你能理解。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Oh...?
Hey, what are
you doing here...?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
哦...？
嘿，你在這裡做什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I can tell that you're not cut out to be an Archer. It sort of feels like you're meant to do
something else...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
看得出來，你並不適合當弓箭手。
總覺得你應該走另一條路...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Good day. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
你好。
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I want to be an Archer.
scripts.translation: 我想成為弓箭手

scripts.text: I need the requirements, please.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我轉職條件

scripts.text: Nothing, thanks.
scripts.translation: 沒事，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You've already become an Archer...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
你已經成為弓箭手了...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Hmm...
You don't look much like a Novice at all...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
嗯...
你看起來完全不像個初心者...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Anyway, whatever you are, you can't choose a job as an Archer because you have a job already.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
總之，不管你是什麼職業，既然已經轉職了，就不能再成為弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Do you want to be an Archer?
If so, you need to fill out this application form.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
你想成為弓箭手嗎？
如果是的話，你需要填寫這份申請表。

scripts.text: Apply.
scripts.translation: 申請

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Okay, sign here. Alright, um, I'll promote you once you meet the requirements.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
好，在這裡簽名。
嗯，滿足條件後，我就為你辦理轉職。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
If you think you've met them already, we can check that now.
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
如果你覺得已經滿足了要求，我們現在就可以檢查。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 準備好了

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 還沒準備好

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Alright, let me check.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
好的，讓我檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I understand. Be my guest if you want to look at the requirements.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
明白了。
想了解轉職條件的話，儘管問。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well, alright.
See you next time.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
好吧。
下次再見。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Are you...{0}?
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
你是...{0}嗎？

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Well, you're not at the right job level. Please check the requirements again.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
你的職業等級還沒達到要求。
請再確認一下轉職條件。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Your job level must be at least 10, and don't forget you should learn all of the Basic Skills. Once you've done that, come back.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
你的職業等級必須達到10級以上，還要學會所有基本技能，別忘了。
完成後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Excellent!
Now then,
let's see...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
很好！
接下來，讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I will appraise the value of the various types of Trunks, needed to produce a Bow, that you've brought.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
接下來，我會評估你帶來的各種制弓木材的價值。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Um...
Unfortunately you didn't bring any of the required items. There's nothing for me to appraise.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
嗯...
可惜，你沒帶來任何所需的材料，我沒法評估。

[Archer Guildsman]
Less than 25!? You have to get a grade of at least 25! Come on, try harder!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
不到25分？！
至少要拿到25分才行！
加油，再努力一點！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Wow! More than 40!
Excellent! Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
哇！超過40分了！
太棒了！恭喜你！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
More than 30! Nice job!
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
超過30分了！
幹得不錯！
恭喜你！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
*Sigh* Well, you just barely passed... Anyway, well done.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
*嘆氣*嗯，你只是勉強通過...
不過，還是做得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I'll transfer these Trunks to our Bow Production Department. Now that you've met the requirements, let me promote you right away!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
我會把這些木材轉交給制弓部門。
既然你已經滿足條件，現在就為你辦理轉職吧！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Congratulations!
You are now an Archer!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
恭喜你！
你現在是一名弓箭手了！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Of course, we expect that you will help contribute towards the future of the Archer Guild with your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
當然，我們也期待你能通過自己的努力，為弓箭手公會的未來做出貢獻。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Ah, your bow has arrived from the Bow Production Department. Here, take it! It's yours~
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
啊，制弓部門把你的弓送來了。
拿著吧，這是你的了~

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Now, off you go. Hunt with pride, knowing you were trained by one of the best!
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
好了，出發吧，驕傲地去狩獵！
別忘了，教你的人可是最優秀的導師之一！

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
I will explain the requirements for being an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
我來說明一下成為弓箭手的條件。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
But...
You're already an Archer. You should know these already...
So...Yeah...no real reason to tell you the requirements...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
不過...
你已經是弓箭手了，應該早就知道這些了吧...
所以...嗯...也沒必要再跟你解釋轉職條件了...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
Wait a second. You've chosen a different job already. You don't need to know this~
So...Yeah...no real reason to tell you the requirements...
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
等一下，你已經選了其他職業，不需要了解這些啦~
所以...嗯...也沒必要跟你解釋轉職條件了...

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
First of all, you have to the Job Level 9 as a Novice, and know all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
首先，你的初心者職業等級必須達到9級，並學會所有基本技能。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
An Archer needs extremely high concentration and reflexes, so we do not accept those who have little patience.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
弓箭手需要極高的專注力和反應速度，所以我們不接受缺乏耐心的人。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
You also have to gather ^FF0000Trunks^000000. There are 4 different types of Trunks, each of differing quality. You'll be given different grades for your Trunks, depending on their quality.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
你還需要收集^FF0000木材^000000。
木材共有4種，品質各不相同。
我會根據品質，給你帶來的木材評分。

scripts.text:
[Archer Guildsman]
In order to become an Archer, you must receive a grade of at least ^0000FF25^000000 points out of 40. You can get Trunks from 'Willow,' the tree. Be careful, though. They can be tough monsters.
scripts.translation:
[弓箭手公會成員]
想成為弓箭手，必須在40分中至少拿到^0000FF25^000000分。
木材可以從樹精身上獲得。
不過要小心，它們可不是好對付的魔物。
